sections.A: Pneumonia phephron ke tissue ka infection hai jis mein hawa ki thailiyan sozish wale paani se bhar jati hain (consolidation).
sections.B: Physio un maslon mein madad karti hai jaise balgham ruk jana (khurdari aawaz, kamzor khansi) aur phephre ka kam phoolna.
sections.C: Khansi ki taaqat, balgham ka rang aur miqdar, aur kya dard gehri saans rokta hai.
sections.D: Vital signs, oxygen ki zaroorat, seene ki aawaz aur khansi ki taaqat.
sections.G: Barhti oxygen ki zaroorat, bohat tez saans, confusion ya girta BP (sepsis): pehle medical team ko batayein.
sections.H: Patient bigar raha hai to pehle medical team. Balgham ruka hai to airway clearance. Sirf consolidation ho to physio se seedha faida nahi.
sections.I: Positioning (behtar phephra upar), ACBT, huffing aur assisted cough qadam ba qadam.
sections.J: Bethne se chalne tak, phir discharge se pehle exercise program.
sections.M: Seene ki aawaz, SpO2 aur oxygen, balgham ka nikalna, saans ki raftaar aur mobility dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Airway clearance consolidation ko nahi hatata, kyunki woh hawa ki thailiyon ke andar hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
